sloka: सुग्रीवश्च महातेजाः स त्वां कुशलमब्रवीत् ।धर्मार्थकामसहितं हितं पथ्यमुवाच च ।। ५.५८.१३४ ।।।।
transliteration: sugrīvaśca mahātejāḥ sa tvāṁ kuśalamabravīt ।dharmārthakāmasahitaṁ hitaṁ pathyamuvāca ca ।। 5.58.134 ।।।।

translations.english: 'Highly powerful Sugriva enquires your welfare. He sends beneficial advice to you for your righteousness, pleasures and wellbeing.
